description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shambling Ghast on top of your library.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Shambling Ghast from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast by paying {B}.
Repeat.
